invariant: A named floating note is a real NOTE leaf stored on the same Plasma quark used by every other class-diagram entity. CommandFactoryNote resolves the alias with quarkInContext(false), so an unqualified alias is created under the current package even when another package contains a same-named leaf. reallyCreateLeaf stores the NOTE Entity on that quark. CommandLinkClass later resolves both endpoints with quarkInContextSafe(true); a unique unqualified alias therefore returns the existing note quark and its non-null data prevents construction of a phantom CLASS. The Link retains the note Entity itself. GraphvizImageBuilder can consequently count the note's links, consume a singly linked note edge as Opale, preserve the package-qualified SVG identity from Quark.getQualifiedName, and use the local Quark.getName for link comments and path IDs.
causal_divergence: Rust ClassParser stores floating aliases only in Note.alias and emits a UID event. It does not register the note's canonical quark path or make that path resolvable as relationship endpoint data. A later relationship does register the alias path, but materialize_relationship_endpoint sees neither an entity nor a package and creates a CLASS at that path. finish contains a post-hoc filter that removes phantom entities only when ClassEntity.id exactly equals an unqualified note alias. That masks the root case while leaving a package-owned phantom such as Archive.Floating alive, and it cannot restore the constructor UID stream, package traversal, solved graph, note link count, or endpoint identity that were already corrupted. Renderer lookups repeat the same unqualified-alias assumption, so simply broadening the final filter would still fail to connect the relationship to the note.
planned_change: Represent each named floating note with both its local alias and canonical quark identity. When push_note commits a named note, resolve its path with the same current-context, non-reusing semantics as Java quarkInContext(false), register that path in Plasma creation order before the note UID event, and index the path as NOTE data. Relationship endpoint selection continues to use the existing reuse-unique quark algorithm; materialization returns the note's canonical identity when the selected path belongs to a note and never creates a class. Remove the post-hoc phantom filter. Teach renderer endpoint, layout-node, SVG-ID, short-name, and Opale-link lookups to resolve either canonical note identity or the local alias for backward-compatible deserialized diagrams. Do not change layout constants, comparator behavior, or SVG strings after rendering.
perturbation_axes: relationship declared inside the owning package versus after the package is reopened
note as source versus note as target
one relationship eligible for Opale versus two relationships requiring ordinary SvekEdges
same local alias in separate packages versus one globally unique alias
